# Exact live WorkflowEngine method observed on 2026-10-13. It deliberately
# omits private source rows; the portal must recover context by the same ID.
@staticmethod
def _pagination_option_snapshot(options: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """Guarda somente os dados visuais necessários às páginas seguintes."""
    return [
        copy.deepcopy(
            {
                key: value
                for key, value in item.items()
                if key != "source_values"
            }
        )
        for item in options
    ]
